column1: # Example: high-confidence phosphoproteins of a clinical Mycobacterium tuberculosis Beijing isolate (strain family Beijing, grown in vitro), top 150 proteins by phosphosite Andromeda score.

# Source: Fortuin S, Tomazella GG, Nagaraj N, et al. (2015) Phosphoproteomics analysis of a clinical Mycobacterium tuberculosis Beijing isolate: expanding the mycobacterial phosphoproteome catalog. Front Microbiol 6:6. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2015.00006

# Table1.XLSX, sheet "Table S1" (Europe PMC PMC4322841). Cutoff: the paper's own acceptance criteria for high-confidence localized phosphosites, localization probability >= 0.75 and PEP <= 0.01; 330 of 464 listed sites pass, on 216 proteins; the top 150 proteins by best site score are kept. Licensed CC BY (CC BY 4.0 under Frontiers); values as published.

# Columns: protein = gene symbol in the LIVIA Atlas Mycobacterium tuberculosis index, mapped from the table's Rv number or UniProt accession (unmapped rows keep the table's own name); uniprot = index accession; name_in_table / rv_number as given; phospho_sites = number of high-confidence sites on that protein; best_score = highest Andromeda score among them.
# 109 of the 150 proteins map to the index (73%).
